item.text: The recursion-limit adjustment alone cannot solve this because Python’s JSON encoder has its own deep-container failure behavior. I’m adding an iterative deep JSON path for the generated nested-array cases, making flatten iterative, and avoiding recursive self-merging when jq merges the same deep value. These are general depth-safety fixes, not case-specific bypasses.
